SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Harrowgate Digestive Clinic (fictional)
Upper endoscopy report
Date of service: 2026-10-16
Findings
The gastroscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum. In the distal esophagus at 32 and 34 cm linear erosions were biopsied with cold forceps. The stomach and duodenum were normal.
Impression
Erosive esophagitis, biopsied.
